integrity: The mathematical statements follow from the included graph-theoretic proof. Computational checks do not establish infinite-range correctness; the originality comparison is non-exhaustive and is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: One full edge-subdivision per complete graph; the proof covers all n >= 3. The finite verifier checks direct subsets only for 3 <= n <= 6 and symbolic coefficients through n = 11. A broad related dissertation could not be inspected in full; priority remains subject to additional literature review.
title: A residue-class transition for open-separating codes of clique subdivisions
